title: Dasharatha refuses to spare Rama
introduction: On enquiring details about those dangerous demons that are ravaging sage's ritual, King Dasharatha refuses to send young Rama along with Sage Vishvamitra on many an account, and thus confronts the Sage's wrath.
closing: इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे विंशः सर्गः ||
Thus, this is the 20th chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
तच्छ्रुत्वा राजशार्दूलो विश्वामित्रस्य भाषितम् |
मुहूर्तमिव निस्सज्ञः सज्ञावानिदमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tat śrutvā rāja śārdūlo viśvāmitrasya bhāṣitam |
muhūrtam iva nissajñaḥ sajñāvān idam abravīt
verses.translation: On hearing what is spoken by Vishvamitra the tigerly-king Dasharatha became insensate for a time, and on redeeming senses he said this.

glosses.meaning: for a time, thus, became senseless

verses.devanagari:
ऊनषोडशवर्षो मे रामो राजीवलोचनः |
न युद्धयोग्यतामस्य पश्यामि सह राक्षसैः
verses.iast:
ūna ṣoḍaśa varṣo me rāmo rājīva locanaḥ |
na yuddha yogyatām asya paśyāmi saha rāxasaiḥ
verses.translation: ""Less than sixteen years of age is my lotus-eyed Rama, and I see no warring aptitude to him with the demons.
notes: This particular statement ūna ṣoḍaśa varśaḥ less than sixteen years, has evoked a spate of commentaries in deciding the age of Rama at this juncture of going along with Sage Viswamitra, i.e., at the time of his marrying Seeta and at the time of his exile to forests etc. His age is said to be twelve years as of now. And this is confirmed by Mareecha while advising Ravana, that 'as a boy of twelve Rama, killed my mother and brother, and hit me out' as at 3-38-6, ūna dvādaśa varṣaḥ Or, bālo dvādaśa varṣo ayam as per other versions of the same verse.

Ramayana has some bearing on the number twelve. The Books or Kaanda-s are 6, half of twelve. The total verses are 24 thousand, two folds of twelve thousand. Rama is born in twelfth month. Vishvamitra's arrival, or better said as ṣeetha kalyaṇa , Seetha's marriage with Rama, is in the twelfth year. His stay in Ayodhya before crown prince ceremony and exile is for twelve years. The years of Rama's exile are twelve, plus two years stay in Panchavati, of the total fourteen years of exile. In Uttara Ramayana Seetha's exile in the hermitage of Valmiki is for twelve years. So on...

Some others said that because Rama has not yet attained all the sixteen phases like full moon, he is not a full-fledged person, cāru ṣoḍaśa kalā sahitaḥ Again in saying: rājīva locana lotus-eyed one - petals of lotuses close down by night, so Rama's eyelids too close by night for a boyish sleep. Then how can such a boy war with night-active demons? In answer to this Sage Vishvamitra uses the same wording in previous chapter at 1-19-18, daśa rātram; rāmam rājīva locanam where the wording rājīva locana is used by Vishvamitra in the sense that the petals of a lotus spread out on the first rays of sun. So also the very opening of the lotus-petal eyelids of Rama will eradicate the nightly menace of demons with his Omniscient Sun-Moon-Fire eyes, sūrya candra agni locana , that can see even in night.

A Kshatriya of sixteen years age is unfit to war with any one, as he is still a childhood bāla āśoḍaśāt varṣā . But Rama is under sixteen, and he is being requisitioned for war. Can he combat even if he is under aged? Yes, he can, says Govindaraja as per the nyaya /syndrome, tejasām hi na vayaḥ samīkśyate 'dextrous person's age is not to be reckoned' As such, though Rama appears to be under aged he can do wonders in eliminating the vice. This is again rounded off with Vishvamitra's wording in last chapter: aham vedmi mahā ātmānam rāmam rājīva locanam.

glosses.meaning: is less than, sixteen, years [of age]

verses.devanagari:
इयमक्षौहिणी पूर्णा यस्याहं पतिरीश्वरः |
अनया संवृतो गत्वा योद्धाहं तैर्निशाचरैः
verses.iast:
iyam akṣauhiṇī senā yasya aham patiḥ īśvaraḥ |
anayā sahito gatvā yoddha aham tair niśācaraiḥ
verses.translation: "Here is the full-fledged battalion, called akshouhiNi sena , for which I am the leader and controller, and fortified by this army I will go there to encounter those demons.
notes: One pankti row, is the first unit of ancient military, which consists of 1 chariot, 1 elephant, 3 cavalry, and 7-foot soldiers. Multiples of this first unit become an akśouhiṇi troop, which consists of 21,870 chariots and the same number of elephants, 65,610 cavalry, and 1,09,350 of foot soldiers.

glosses.meaning: full-fledged one, this one - here is, battalion [of ancient Indian warfare]
for which, I am, the leader
I will, with those, night, walkers [demons,] I can encounter.

verses.devanagari:
इमे शूराश्च विक्रान्ता भृत्या मेऽस्त्रविशारदाः |
योग्या रक्षोगणैर्योद्धुं न रामं नेतुमर्हसि
verses.iast:
ime śūrāḥ ca vikrāntā bhṛtyāḥ me astra viśāradāḥ |
yogyā rakṣogaṇaiḥ yoddhum na rāmam netum arhasi
verses.translation: "Brave and daring are these soldiers of mine, and as experts in weaponry they are the appropriate ones to combat the hordes of demons, but, it will be ungentle of you to take Rama with you.

verses.devanagari:
अहमेव धनुष्पाणिर्गोप्ता समरमूर्धनि |
यावत् प्राणान् धरिष्यामि तावद्योत्स्ये निशाचरैः
verses.iast:
aham eva dhanuṣpāṇiḥ goptā samara mūrdhani |
yāvat prāṇān dhariṣyāmi tāvat yotsye niśācaraiḥ
verses.translation: "I alone with bow in my hand can protect your ritual, and as long as I bear my lives so long I war with those nightwalkers staying in the van of war.

glosses.meaning: as long as, lives, I bear

verses.devanagari:
निर्विघ्ना व्रतचर्या सा भविष्यति सुरक्षिता |
अहं तत्रागमिष्यामि न रामं नेतुमर्हसि
verses.iast:
nirvighnā vrata caryā sā bhaviṣyati surakṣitā |
aham tatra āgamiṣyāmi na rāmam netum arhasi
verses.translation: " I myself wish to come over there thereby the works of ritual will be well-guarded and unimpeded, but, taking Rama with you will be ungracious of you.

glosses.meaning: I am, over there, to come, I wish
Rama, to take with you, inapt of you.

verses.devanagari:
बालो ह्यकृतविद्यश्च न च वेत्ति बलाबलम् |
न चास्त्रबलसंयुक्तो न च युद्धविशारदः
न चासौ रक्षसां योग्यः कूटयुद्धा हि ते ध्रुवम् |
verses.iast:
bālo hi akṛta vidyaḥ ca na ca vetti balābalam |
na ca astra bala saṃyuk{}to na ca yuddha viśāradaḥ
na ca asau rakṣasā yogyaḥ kūṭa yuddhā hi rākśasā |
verses.translation: "Why because, Rama is boy! And he is unschooled in his princely education; does he know the strengths and weaknesses of opponents - no; has he got the equipage of arsenal - no; has he any expertise in warfare - no; is he an equal to the demons - no; be that as it may, those demons definitely conduct a deceitful warfare, isn't it.

glosses.meaning: missiles, accumulation [- arsenal,] he is along with
he is not, - he has no equipage of arsenal
in warfare, he is an expert, also
to those, demons, as a match, equal
those, definitely, with deceitful, warfare, isn't it.

verses.devanagari:
विप्रयुक्तो हि रामेण मुहूर्तमपि नोत्सहे
जीवितुं मुनिशार्दूल न रामं नेतुमर्हसि |
verses.iast:
viprayuk{}to hi rāmeṇa muhūrtam api na utsahe
jīvitum muni śārdūla na rāmam netum a.rhasi |
verses.translation: "Alienated from Rama I am disinclined to live even for a moment, oh, tigerly sage, hence taking Rama with you will be unjust.

glosses.meaning: Rama, to take with you, not, apt of you.

verses.devanagari:
यदि वा राघवं ब्रह्मन्नेतुमिच्छसि सुव्रत
चतुरंगसमायुक्तं मया सह च तं नय |
verses.iast:
yadi vā rāghavam brahman netum icchasi suvrata
caturaṅga samāyuk{}tam mayā saha ca tam naya |
verses.translation: "Otherwise, oh, Brahman with best vows, if you so wish to take Rama along with you, you lead him off along with me, and along with my four kinds of troops.
notes: The four kinds of troops are: chariots, elephants, cavalry, and foot soldiers.

glosses.meaning: Rama, to take away, you wish, if
four kinds of troops, along with

verses.devanagari:
षष्टिर्वर्षसहस्राणि जातस्य मम कौशिक
कृच्छ्रेणोत्पादितश्चायं न रामं नेतुमर्हसि |
verses.iast:
ṣaṣṭiḥ varṣa sahasrāṇi jātasya mama kauśika
kṛcchreṇa utpāditaḥ ca ayam na rāmam netum a.rhasi |
verses.translation: "Sixty thousand years have passed from my birth, oh! Vishvamitra, and this Rama is engendered at this age, that too with tribulations, hence taking Rama with you will be inappropriate of you.

glosses.meaning: sixty, years, thousands [sixty thousand years passed]
Rama, to take with you, not, apt of you.

verses.devanagari:
चतुर्णामात्मजानां हि प्रीतिः परमिका मम
ज्येष्ठे धर्मप्रधाने च न रामं नेतुमर्हसि |
verses.iast:
caturṇām ātmajānām hi prītiḥ paramikā mama
jyeṣṭhe dharma pradhāne ca na rāmam netum a.rhasi |
verses.translation: "I will have exceptional affection for all of my four sons, isn't it, and among them Rama has a significance in the matter of his descent as an eldest son, hence taking Rama with you will be unjust of you.

glosses.meaning: for four, of my soul, born sons
to me, exceptional, affection is there, isn't it
[in view of rightness [of descent ,] significance, also - as he is the next king, do not butcher him now
Rama, to take with you, not, apt of you.

verses.devanagari:
किं वीर्या राक्षसास्ते च कस्य पुत्राश्च के च ते
कथं प्रमाणाः के चैतान् रक्षन्ति मुनिपुंगव |
verses.iast:
kim vīryāḥ rākṣasāḥ te ca kasya putrāḥ ca ke ca te
katham pramāṇāḥ ke ca etān rakṣanti munipuṅgava |
verses.translation: "Oh, eminent sage, of what fortitude are those demons? Whose sons are they? Who are they? How is their size and shape? Also who protects all of them?

glosses.meaning: who, also, all of them, protecting.

verses.devanagari:
कथं च प्रतिकर्तव्यं तेषां रामेण रक्षसाम्
मामकैर्वा बलैर्ब्रह्मन् मया वा कूटयोधिनाम् |
verses.iast:
katham ca prati kartavyam teṣām rāmeṇa rakṣasām
māmakaiḥ vā balaiḥ brahman mayā vā kūṭa yodhinām |
verses.translation: "Oh, Brahman, how Rama, or my forces, or I myself have to retaliate those demons that are deceitful militants.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वं मे शंस भगवन् कथं तेषां मया रणे
स्थातव्यं दुष्टभावानां वीर्योत्सिक्ता हि राक्षसाः |
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा विश्वामित्रोऽभ्यभाषत
verses.iast:
sarvam me śaṃsa bhagavan katham teṣām mayā raṇe
sthātavyam duṣṭa bhāvānām vīryotsik{}tā hi rākṣasāḥ |
tasya tad vacanam śrutvā viśvāmitro abhyabhāṣata
verses.translation: "Tell me all that, oh, god, how I have to carry on when warring with those evil minded demons, for the demons will be delirious by their audacity, isn't it..." Thus Dasharatha asked Vishvamitra insistently. On hearing those words Sage Vishvamitra replied this way.

glosses.meaning: with them, in war, how, by me, to stand - to carry out
demons, by audacity, delirious, isn't it

verses.devanagari:
पौलस्त्यवंशप्रभवो रावणो नाम राक्षसः |
स ब्रह्मणा दत्तवरस्त्रैलोक्यं बाधते भृशम्
महाबलो महावीर्यो राक्षसैर्बहुभिर्वृतः |
verses.iast:
paulastya vaṃśa prabhavo rāvaṇo nāma rākṣasaḥ |
sa brahmaṇā datta varaḥ trailokyam bādhate bhṛśam
mahābalo mahāvīryo rākṣasaiḥ bahubhiḥ vṛtaḥ |
verses.translation: "One born in Paulastya dynasty, an extremely mighty and exceedingly brave demon named Ravana is there, and he with the boon given by Brahma, and accompanied with many other demons is torturing the triad of worlds, contemptuously.

glosses.meaning: with many, demons, surrounded with [accompanied with]

verses.devanagari:
श्रूयते च महाराजा रावणो राक्षसाधिपः
साक्षाद्वैश्रवणभ्राता पुत्रो विश्रवसो मुनेः |
verses.iast:
śrūyate ca mahārājā rāvaṇo rākṣasa adhipaḥ
sākṣāt vaiśravaṇa bhrātā putro viśravaso muneḥ |
verses.translation: "Unequivocally that chief of demons is the brother of Kubera and the son of sage Vishravasa, thus we hear.

verses.devanagari:
यदा न खलु यज्ञस्य विघ्नकर्ता महाबलः
तेन संचोदितौ तौ तु राक्षसौ च महाबलौ |
मारीचश्च सुबाहुश्च यज्ञविघ्नं करिष्यतः
verses.iast:
yadā na khalu yajñasya vighna kartā mahābalaḥ
tena sañcoditau tau tu rākṣasau ca mahābalau |
mārīcaḥ ca subāhuḥ ca yajña vighnam kariṣyataḥ
verses.translation: "That formidable Ravana is not a devastator of rituals by himself, even so, two very mighty demons called Mareecha and Subaahu will cause devastating hindrances to rituals, instigated by him." Thus Sage Vishvamitra said to Dasharatha.

glosses.itrans: yadaa yaj~nasya vighna kartaa na khalu
glosses.iast: yadā yajñasya vighna kartā na khalu
glosses.devanagari: यदा यज्ञस्य विघ्न कर्ता न खलु
glosses.meaning: when, rituals, hindrances - devastation, causer, not, indeed

verses.devanagari:
इत्युक्तो मुनिना तेन राजोवाच मुनिं तदा |
न हि शक्तोऽस्मि संग्रामे स्थातुं तस्य दुरात्मनः
verses.iast:
iti ukto muninā tena rājA uvāca munim tadā |
na hi śakto asmi saṅgrāme sthātum tasya durātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Thus when he is said so by that sage Vishvamitra, then the king Dasharatha spoke to the sage, "I myself am not capable of standing against that evil minded Ravana, in truth, where is the question of deputing my young Rama to confront him?

glosses.meaning: thus, by that, sage, one who is said
king Dasharatha, then, to sage, spoke
to stand [against him,] not, capable, I am, in truth

verses.devanagari:
स त्वं प्रसादं धर्मज्ञ कुरुष्व मम पुत्रके |
मम चैवाल्पभाग्यस्य दैवतं हि भवान् गुरुः
verses.iast:
sa tvam prasādam dharmajña kuruṣva mama putrake |
mama ca eva alpa bhAgyasya daivatam hi bhavAn guruḥ
verses.translation: "You are the knower of probity, such as you are, you may please bestow benevolence upon my boyish son, as well on a less fortunate one like me too, and as our mentor you are indeed a god of ours.

glosses.meaning: less, fortunate, one me, also, thus

verses.devanagari:
देवदानवगंधर्वा यक्षाः पतगपन्नगाः|
न शक्ता रावणं सोढुं किं पुनर्मानवा युधि
verses.iast:
deva dānava gandharvā yakṣāḥ pataga pannagāḥ |
na śaktā rāvaṇam soḍhum kim punar mānavā yudhi
verses.translation: "Gods, demons, celestial beings like gandharva-s, yaksha-s, winged and reptile beings are incapable to bear the brunt of that Ravana in fight, why tell again about humans.

verses.devanagari:
स तु वीर्यवतां वीर्यमादत्ते युधि रावणः |
तेन चाहं न शक्तोऽस्मि संयोद्धुं तस्य वा बलैः
सबलो वा मुनिश्रेष्ठ सहितो वा ममात्मजैः |
verses.iast:
sa tu vīryavatām vīryam ādatte yudhi rāvaṇaḥ |
tena ca aham na śakto'smi saṃyoddhum tasya vā balaiḥ
sabalo vā muniśreṣṭha sahito vā mama ātmajaiḥ |
verses.translation: "But that Ravana depletes the valour of valorous opponents in a battle, oh, eminent sage, either with my entire forces, or with all my sons I am inadequate to grapple with all his forces, or with him, individually.

verses.devanagari:
कथमप्यमरप्रख्यं संग्रामाणामकोविदम्
बालं मे तनयं ब्रह्मन्नैव दास्यामि पुत्रकम् |
verses.iast:
katham api amara prakhyam saṅgrāmāṇām akovidam
bālam me tanayam brahman naiva dāsyāmi putrakam |
verses.translation: "My boyish son is godlike and unfledged in warfare, oh, Brahman, and he is the one who alleviates me from punnama naraka the hell of sonless fathers... no, I cannot spare my son in anyway.

glosses.meaning: godlike [for Rama is still a boy]
a son who alleviates hell of sonless fathers

verses.devanagari:
अथ कालोपमौ युद्धे सुतौ सुन्दोपसुन्दयोः
यज्ञविघ्नकरौ तौ ते नैव दास्यामि पुत्रकम् |
verses.iast:
atha kāla upamau yuddhe sutau sundopasundayoḥ
yajña vighna karau tau te na eva dāsyāmi putrakam |
verses.translation: "Further, those saboteurs of your ritual namely Mareecha and Subaahu, are similar to Death-god and the descendents of the earliest demons and subverters of rituals, namely Sunda and Upasunda, no, I cannot spare my son, in any case.

glosses.meaning: demons Sunda, Upasunda, sons of [ viz., descendants of]
son, not, in any way, I spare.

verses.devanagari:
मारीचश्च सुबाहुश्च वीर्यवन्तौ सुशिक्षितौ
तयोरन्यतरं योद्धुं यास्यामि ससुहृद्गणः |
अन्यथा त्वनुनेष्यामि भवन्तं सह बान्धवैः
verses.iast:
mārīcaḥ ca subāhuḥ ca vīryavantau suśikṣitau
tayoḥ anyataram yoddhum yāsyāmi sa suhṛt gaṇaḥ |
anyathā tvanuneṣyāmi bhavantam saha bāndhava
verses.translation: "Mareecha and Subaahu are well-trained and valorous ones, hence I will proceed with all my friendly forces to war with either of those two demons, otherwise, I along with all my relatives implore upon you for your exoneration in my failure to comply my own promises.

glosses.meaning: with one only [either of the two demons,] to war

verses.devanagari:
इति नरपतिजल्पनाद्द्विजेन्द्रं
कुशिकसुतं सुमहान् विवेश मन्युः |
सुहुत इव मखेऽग्निराज्यसिक्तः
समभवदुज्वलितो महर्षिवह्निः
verses.iast:
iti narapati jalpanāt dvijendram
kuśika sutam sumahAn viveśa manyuḥ |
su huta iva makhe agniḥ Ajya sik{}taḥ
samabhavat ujvalito maharṣi vahniḥ
verses.translation: Thus, by the incongruous talk of Dasharatha, the outstanding Brahman and son of Sage Kushi, namely sage Vishvamitra is overwhelmed with outrageous anger by his mentation, and that fire-like glorious sage looked like the ritual fire into which many inflammable oblations are offered, and which is drenched with a lot of clarified butter, whereby it is flaring up its tongues.

glosses.meaning: to sage Kushi's, son - to Vishvamitra
